title: Meet the Pulitzer Prize Winner Who Stood Up for Gaza - and Exposed Jeff Bezos’s Insane Wealth
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
What does being wealthy in America actually _mean_? And how much money does a
person need to feel secure? On this week's 'We're Not Kidding,' **Mehdi** sits
down with Pulitzer Prize-winning data journalist, illustrator, author and
fellow Brit-in-America **Mona Chalabi** to discuss her new book, _[Ten Lives:
How What We Have Shapes Who We
Are](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/676680/ten-lives-by-mona-
chalabi/)_. The book follows 10 Americans across 10 different income brackets,
exploring the role that wealth, class, and inequality play in shaping our
lives.

**" Are Americans finally beginning to understand the role of class in
politics, in society?"** Mehdi asks.

**" Yes and no. I think our focus on the billionaire class is absolutely
correct,"** Mona says. **" Is that really a conversation about class?... The
truth is, the 99% of us aren't all in it together."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Mona talks about her unconventional approach to data journalism which
incorporates original illustrations that visualize data in unique ways, like
her Pulitzer-winning work depicting [Jeff Bezos' staggering
wealth](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2022/04/07/magazine/jeff-bezos-
net-worth.html). The two also unpack why young people may be more class-
conscious than previous generations, and how politicians across the political
spectrum are increasingly embracing economic populist rhetoric.

Mehdi also asks Mona about her decision to [speak
out](https://youtu.be/NntumEPCQgg?si=-uH9e05J2ORWSIHU&t=2843) for Palestine at
the Pulitzer ceremony in 2023 - just 12 days after October 7th. **" Were you
not worried about getting canceled? What are you thinking in that moment?"**
Mehdi asks. **" I'm not thinking about myself. I'm really, really not,"** Mona
says. **" I was just thinking again about journalists in Palestine."**
